the SWI/Snf complex is comprised of two members of the ARP family, and that ARP family members may be important in the function of the SWI complex.
the actin-related proteins (ARPs) that were originally identified as components of the actin cytoskeleton have now been identified as components of chromatin-remodeling complexes.
